Omar Abdullah and Nidhi Razdan marry in Kashmir; fatwa issued against union

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has married journalist Nidhi Razdan in a private ceremony in Kashmir. The marriage has reportedly drawn a fatwa from a religious group, which has declared the union 'invalid'. Details about the wedding ceremony itself are sparse, with reports describing it as a 'low-key union'. The coverage also notes that Abdullah is the Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir.
